roads.name: Road 181
words: Sweeping and steady: 20 curves in 6.4 miles.
From 3,839 to 3,920 ft, with 484 ft of up and down along the way.
roads.ratingNote: Bars show where it sits among the region's roads; the numbers are each part's share of the rating. At the 55 mph limit its corners still ask for about 0.61 g, so the curves, not the limit, set the pace.
